description: Header file implementing AVX512-based functions for packing and unpacking IQ samples in various bit-width formats (9, 14, 16 bits) in big-endian format, used for resource block compression in a radio system.

methods.name: avx512_pack_prb_9b_big_endian
methods.description: Pack 16-bit IQ values into 9-bit big-endian format using AVX512 instructions.

methods.name: avx512_pack_prb_14b_big_endian
methods.description: Pack 16-bit IQ values into 14-bit big-endian format using AVX512 instructions.

methods.name: avx512_pack_prb_16b_big_endian
methods.description: Pack 16-bit IQ values into 16-bit big-endian format using AVX512 instructions.

methods.name: pack_prb_big_endian
methods.description: Dispatch function to pack IQ samples into specified bit-width format.

methods.name: avx512_unpack_prb_9b_be
methods.description: Unpack 9-bit big-endian packed IQ samples into 16-bit signed values.

methods.name: avx512_unpack_prb_14b_be
methods.description: Unpack 14-bit big-endian packed IQ samples into 16-bit signed values.

methods.name: avx512_unpack_prb_16b_be
methods.description: Unpack 16-bit big-endian packed IQ samples into 16-bit signed values.

methods.name: unpack_prb_big_endian
methods.description: Dispatch function to unpack IQ samples from specified bit-width format.

methods.name: iq_width_packing_supported
methods.description: Check if a given IQ bit-width is supported for packing/unpacking.
